priv.sub: Thank you for using our application, Shopping List. We are committed to protecting your privacy while you use our application. This Privacy Policy describes the data we collect, how it is used, and your rights regarding your personal information.
priv.p1.1: Our application does not require you to create an account or provide personal information. We do not collect, store, or share any personal data such as your name, email address, or payment information.
priv.p1.2: To improve the application's functionality and understand how it is used, we collect anonymous usage data through Google Analytics. This data helps us analyze user interactions and identify the countries from which the application is accessed. The data is not personal and is used solely to improve the application experience.
priv.p1.3: Our application uses LocalStorage and IndexedDB to store data locally on your device. This data is used exclusively to enhance your user experience and is not shared with third parties. The stored information may include your preferences, lists, or temporary data required for application functionality, but it is only stored on your device and is not transmitted to any server.
priv.p2.1: We use Google Analytics to track usage data, such as our users' countries of origin and how the application is used. This helps us improve application performance and user experience. Google Analytics does not collect Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and the collected data is aggregated for analysis purposes.
priv.p2.2: For more information about how Google Analytics collects and processes data, please refer to the
priv.p3.1: Data stored in LocalStorage and IndexedDB remains on your device and can only be accessed by the application. You can remove this data at any time by clearing your browser cache or the application's data settings. We do not store this information on any server or in the cloud.
priv.p4.1: Our application does not share your data with third-party services except for Google Analytics, which is used for tracking and analytical purposes. The data shared with Google Analytics is anonymous and does not contain any personally identifiable information.
priv.p5.1: Since our application does not collect personal information, no specific rights or actions regarding your data are required. However, you may delete locally stored data on your device at any time by clearing your browser cache or the application's data settings.
priv.p6.1: We take reasonable precautions to protect the data stored locally on your device. However, since we do not store personal information or sensitive data, the risk of a data breach is minimal. We recommend keeping your device and browser secure.
priv.p7.1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will publish the updated version on this page. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.
priv.p8.1: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please feel free to contact me. You can find many useful links on the information page.
